title: Drunk Entitled Karen Gets Arrested
description:
On August 11, 2021, police received a call of a woman that was inside a bar, intoxicated, attacking a bunch of people, and refusing to leave in La Crosse, WI. Due to her behavior rapidly escalating throughout the night and a prior call she was involved in that day, officers made the decision to place her under arrest for disorderly conduct.
